headline: From Veranda Learning to Fibe: Vivek Sapre joins fintech firm as CHRO
summary: Fintech company Fibe has appointed Vivek Sapre as its new Chief Human Resources Officer to lead its people strategy and organizational capability. Sapre transitions from Veranda Learning Solutions, where he served as CHRO for nearly three years. His career spans cross-functional experience across human resources, technology, financial services, and consulting at firms including EY, Infosys, and L&T Finance.

headline: OpenAI safety exit sparks HR alarm
summary: Former safety specialist David Robinson has resigned from OpenAI, publicly criticizing the company for prioritizing rapid product launches over thorough risk management. Although OpenAI defended its protocols by noting it pauses releases when safety concerns arise, Robinson argued that AI capabilities are outpacing alignment and governance efforts. His high-profile exit underscores critical organizational tensions between maintaining high-speed innovation and ensuring employee confidence in corporate governance.
